title: My Parents Are Actually Villains 🕵️
topic: Nix discovers his parents are the masterminds behind the school's surveillance system.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: STOP TELLING LIES ABOUT MY FAMILY RIGHT NOW [beat] BECAUSE THERE IS NO WAY MY DAD WOULD EVER WORK FOR SOMEONE AS CORRUPT AS YOU!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Oh Nix, you poor naive boy [beat] go home and look inside that dusty old toolbox in the garage that your father never lets you touch.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I ran home faster than I ever have before [beat] and my heart was pounding against my ribs like a drum while I looked for that hidden silver key.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Nix! What on earth are you doing digging through my private things [beat] when I specifically told you to stay out of this garage for your own safety?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I found it dad [beat] the blue folder with the school crest on it and a list of every student’s private data including mine and my friends!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: You weren't supposed to see that yet [beat] the project is way bigger than just one school and your mother is actually the one who started it.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Close the folder Nix [beat] the Principal is just a middleman and we are the ones who decide who gets to stay in this city or who gets erased.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: My own parents are running a mass surveillance operation [beat] and they are using the school as a front to collect data on every family in town!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Don't act so surprised Nix [beat] I’ve been coding the encryption for them for three years and I'm the one who leaked the files just to bait you.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You guys are monsters [beat] you’re literally ruining people’s lives just to build some perfect society that only benefits people like us!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: We are protecting you from the chaos outside [beat] but since you found the master key, we can't let you leave this house ever again.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Why is the front door locking itself [beat] and why is there a red countdown timer appearing on every single screen in the living room right now?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I told you the rabbit hole was deep Nix [beat] now witness the activation of the real project in three, two, one, and say goodbye to the old world!
